dct_description_sm: This project was centered around a vulnerability assessment and adaptation planning framework in order to aid the community in adapting to climate change. Located between two ecosystems, a forest and an agricultural plain, the community must contend with two systems changing differently, and requiring different adaptation strategies.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Traditional Knowledge
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community vulnerability
dct_title_s: Climate Change Vulnerability Assessment, Adaptation Planning And Knowledge Transfer For Beardy's And Okemasis First Nation, Saskatchewan
